item.title: Grammy 1.8
item.description:
Fixed

  • Grammy now works with Anthropic's newer personal and service account API keys, not just the older workspace ones. If a key covers several workspaces, Grammy asks which to use, or picks it for you when there's only one, and you can change it later in Settings.

item.title: Grammy 1.7
item.description:
New

  • More kinds of diagrams: timelines for anything dated or phased, loops for cycles and feedback, bar charts for comparing amounts, and tables for comparing options side by side.

Improved

  • Diagrams that would come out very wide or very tall rearrange themselves to fit, so the text stays readable.
  • Long flows wrap onto several lines instead of stretching off to the side.
  • Two-way links, like a task going out and an answer coming back, are drawn side by side instead of on top of each other.
  • If Claude returns an almost empty diagram for a detailed description, Grammy quietly tries again.

item.title: Grammy 1.6
item.description:
New

  • Live edits (experimental): turn it on in Settings, and the diagram sketches itself while you're still talking, then finishes on the one you watched build.
  • A close button in the pill's corner when you hover over a diagram.
  • A simpler Settings window, with your shortcuts shown at the top.
  • A shorter, clearer setup for new users, with example prompts to try first.

Improved

  • Edits use Claude Sonnet, so they follow what you ask more reliably.
  • The pill is a true capsule and animates smoothly between typing, sketching and the finished diagram, with no flashes or clipping.
  • The pointer turns into a hand over the diagram, and one click opens the editor.
  • Links that loop back or skip past boxes are drawn around them, not through them.
  • Bigger edits to detailed diagrams no longer fail partway through, and if a change is too big to draw at once, Grammy says so.
  • A fresh look, using Manrope.

Fixed

  • Opening Settings could crash Grammy.
  • Opening the composer could flash your last diagram.

item.title: Grammy 1.5
item.description:
New

  • Grammy now updates itself. It checks once a day and offers new versions when they're ready, or choose Check for Updates… in the menu. This is the last time you'll need to download Grammy by hand.
